id_clinic.task_description: Obtain birth certificate, apply for government-issued ID, take photo

housing_pathway.goal_description: Chronic homelessness detected. Establish 6-month pathway to stable housing with wrap-around support including mental health, substance use support, and life skills.

raam_referral.ref description: Rapid Access Addiction Medicine clinic referral

red_path_referral.description: Red Path Recovery Program referral for peer-based recovery support

youth_protection.task_description: Client under 18 has completed intake. Review for mandatory reporting requirements per Ontario Child Protection Act.

emergency_shelter.task_description: Client fleeing violence/abuse. Secure immediate access to emergency shelter at Cornerstone or equivalent.

naloxone_access.condition: (q36 == 'Yes' OR q37 == 'Yes' OR q38 == 'Yes') AND q39 != 'Yes'
naloxone_access.task_description: Provide overdose prevention kit and training on naloxone use. Life-saving emergency measure.

mh_assessment.condition: q26 == 'I am currently seeking an assessment'
mh_assessment.goal_description: Client seeking mental health assessment. Coordinate with NHH Community Mental Health Team or Walk-In Clinic.

crisis_plan.condition: q32 == 'I would like help making one'
crisis_plan.task_description: Work with client to create written plan for managing mental health crises. Include emergency contacts and coping strategies.

peer_support.description: Connect to peer support worker who has lived experience

senior_checkin.goal_description: Enroll in regular check-in service for ongoing safety and wellness monitoring. Bi-weekly or monthly contact per preference.

family_contact.condition: q2 == '60 or older (senior)' AND q48 NOT NULL
family_contact.task_description: Reach out to family member or Power of Attorney identified by client. Coordinate support planning.

meal_assistance.description: Connect to meal planning, grocery shopping, or meal delivery service

legal_support.task_title: Legal Clinic Appointment for Court Proceedings
legal_support.task_description: Arrange free or low-cost legal clinic to prepare for upcoming court date. Document preparation and representation available.

tax_filing.task_title: Community Tax Program - File 2024 Tax Return
tax_filing.task_description: Complete tax filing to access maximum refund and government benefits (GST credit, working tax benefit, etc.). Free community tax program available.

life_skills.description: Enroll in life skills programming: budgeting, cooking, computer basics, conflict resolution

gp_connection.task_description: Connect with available GP in Northumberland County. Discuss health concerns and establish ongoing care.

employment_path.goal_description: Explore paid work, volunteering, hobbies, or structured routine. Build stability through meaningful engagement.

goal_from_client.condition: q60 IS NOT NULL AND q60 != ''
goal_from_client.goal_description: Client's stated 30-day priority goal from intake assessment

aer_detection.alert_message_template: ACUTELY ELEVATED RISK: Crisis cluster score {score}/100. Flags: {flags}. Immediate manager review and safety planning required.

by_name_list_sync.description: Add to Northumberland County By-Name List for prioritized housing placement if chronic homelessness and consented
